payload.core_mechanism_summary: Generate candidate k as a[i] XOR a[j] for all i≠j, intersect these sets over i, output min positive k if non-empty, else -1.
payload.rationale: Solution leverages XOR property that any valid k must pair each element with another, so candidates are precisely pairwise XORs; intersection yields all consistent k. This is an XOR-specific complete candidate enumeration.
